description_en: You can invoke ListUnassignedNumbers to obtain the list of numbers under your Alibaba Cloud account that have not been assigned to an instance
description_zh: 调用ListUnassignedNumbers获取阿里云主账号下未分配到实例的号码列表
name: ListUnassignedNumbers

parameters.description_en: Performs Fuzzy Matching based on the number. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty. An empty value indicates no filtering.
parameters.description_zh: 根据号码进行模糊匹配，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤。
parameters.help_en: Performs Fuzzy Matching based on the number. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty. An empty value indicates no filtering
parameters.help_zh: 根据号码进行模糊匹配，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤
parameters.name: search_pattern

parameters.description_en: Page number for paging, ranging from 1 to 100.
